rows.statement: Watco trip-lever families use an overflow plate, linkage and drop cylinder that seats in the tee.
rows.interpretation: Manufacturer example only; actual tub brand/model is unknown.

rows.statement: Watco Step 7 removes the overflow plate and drop-cylinder assembly for readjustment.
rows.interpretation: Supports asking for a model-specific tub-side assessment; does not prove a seized assembly can be extracted.

rows.statement: Watco instructs that brass linkage must not be kinked.
rows.interpretation: A visible symptom does not identify the failed part without inspection.

rows.statement: For the documented Watco models, the cylinder bottoms slightly before fully closed; a slow drip inside the tee is normal and acceptable.
rows.interpretation: Do not apply this expectation to an unidentified model or confuse internal tee drip with tub sealing failure.
